# Focused engine fixtures

These inputs exercise implementation contracts, not a gallery of authored maps.
AML companions remain beside their source. `rust/` contains frozen cross-language
geometry/material oracles; `migration/` contains inputs for explicit historical
translation. Preserve their geometry, pixel values and provenance. Expected catalog
identities use the current `superspec-material:` scheme; this naming cutover does
not regenerate the numeric or image oracles.

The native CLI owns its starter at `crates/cli/assets/starter.aml`.
Daiban, Dust II, demos and their integrated acceptance belong to the LevelSpec
harness. Existing stale sign-plan snapshots are recorded in
[extraction reuse evidence](../../docs/performance/extraction-reuse.md); assertions
were not weakened to hide them. Historical bake evidence is retained as reference,
not a dependency on retired Node generation scripts.
